description.value: Tindahan Grocery is Richmond's first Filipino grocery store, family-owned and operating since 2002. The store stocks imported Filipino pantry staples — dried and frozen fish, canned goods, noodles, longganisa, tocino — alongside a kitchen helmed by a professionally trained chef with roots in Manila's culinary scene. Cyclists passing through Richmond will find a broad daily rotating menu of traditional Filipino hot dishes, desserts, and fresh empanadas.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 38m; rack at 39m; rack (covered) at 41m; rack at 47m; rack at 57m; rack at 72m; stands (covered) at 75m.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established Filipino grocery and hot-food counter with an active website and current daily menu. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking groceries or a hot meal in Richmond.

Hot food.detail: Daily rotating menu includes Filipino breakfast plates, main dishes (lechon kawali, crispy pata, pork barbecue, fish), desserts, and empanadas; party tray menu available
